testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create a part after navigating to an empty template root ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the standard metric part template is selected ✔ And the template root contains no direct template entries ✔ When the user chooses Home in the template chooser ✔ Then the root is selected and its template groups are empty ✔ And the standard metric part template details remain displayed ✔ When the user chooses Create ✔ Then the chooser closes ✔ And a new empty part document becomes active ✔ And its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker ✔ And a new document tab is visible
